solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: In treatment, Pliny says chaos is revolutionary

indicators.note: something revolutionary overturns the existing order, so these three words are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A reader in therapy remarks that the Roman writer Pliny saw chaos as a force for overthrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Freud's talking cure is a form of psychiatric treatment for the mind.

clue.text: One checks opinion in walk round area with Penny

indicators.note: the walk goes round the other pieces, enclosing them

parts.note: a stroll is a leisurely walk
W is short for with, as in W/O for without
P is the abbreviation for a penny in British money

explanation.surface: Someone takes a walk around the neighbourhood with a friend called Penny, checking what people think.
explanation.definitionFit: An informal survey of views, taken by a show of hands or quick count, checks public opinion.

clue.text: Persons with class throw eggs at first

parts.note: to cast is to throw, as a fishing line

indicators.note: only the opening letter of eggs is wanted

explanation.surface: Posh people pelted with eggs, or a protest where the first thing thrown is eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: A hereditary social group, as in the Hindu system, is a body of people sharing one rank.

clue.text: Ever so odd, Dicky took too many pills

indicators.note: dicky is British slang for weak or unsound, so these letters are out of order

explanation.surface: Someone feeling very strange after swallowing more tablets than they should have.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' (British informal for shaky or faulty, as in a dicky heart) is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To take an excessive amount of a drug is the plain meaning of the verb in the past tense.

clue.text: Better diamonds found in northern river

indicators.note: the diamonds are located inside the other letters

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for river on maps
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: Prospectors report superior gems turning up in a river in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: More pleasant or agreeable is a comparative sense of superior, so both words compare favourably.

clue.text: State girl entraps Scotsman

indicators.note: the girl's name closes around the man's name, holding it inside

parts.note: Louisa is a girl's name
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name, standard in crosswords

explanation.surface: A woman lures and traps a man from Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The southern territory around New Orleans is one of the fifty US states.

clue.text: Commonest name for a forger

definitions.meaning: the most frequent surname in Britain and America
a metalworker who forges iron at a forge, as a blacksmith

explanation.surface: A trick-question about what alias a counterfeiter would use: the most ordinary one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forger' suggests a counterfeiter, but here it is someone working at a forge.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname is the most frequent in English, and the trade word means a metalworker at an anvil.

clue.text: Cool solar area in holiday resort

definitions.meaning: a dark, relatively cooler patch on the Sun's surface
a sunny place where people go on holiday

explanation.surface: A shady, cooler patch to be found at a seaside holiday destination.
explanation.definitionFit: Astronomers name the dark cooler blemishes on the Sun this way, and travel brochures use it for a sunny getaway.

clue.text: Old jokes to entertain by 29's leader

definitions.note: 29 across is Britain's main opposition party; its leader at the time of the puzzle (2016) is meant

indicators.note: entertaining a guest means holding them within, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: corn is trite, old-fashioned humour
taken as written

explanation.surface: A politician who uses stale jokes to amuse his audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 29 is the grid's 14-letter answer, the opposition party, whose head from 2015 to 2020 was Jeremy Corbyn.
explanation.definitionFit: Jeremy Corbyn headed the British opposition party named in 29 across when the puzzle appeared.

clue.text: Giants substitute seen after blunder in field

indicators.note: the substitute is placed following the blunder

parts.note: OG is an own goal, a footballer's blunder on the field
RES is short for reserve, a substitute player

explanation.surface: A football report: the Giants bring on a substitute after a howler on the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Monstrous man-eating giants of folklore are the creatures named.

clue.text: Rude lexicon entertains us in bar

indicators.note: one piece hosts the other inside it
rude in the sense of rough or crude, so the letters of lexicon are roughly treated

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: An offensive dictionary is welcome in the pub, or holds us in its pages.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rude' turns LEXICON into EXCLION, which takes in US.
explanation.definitionFit: To bar someone is to shut them out, and shutting out is the noun's meaning, as in a ban.

clue.text: Perhaps Cockney leader protected swimmer

parts.note: a true Cockney is born within the sound of Bow Bells, the church bells in Bow, east London
a head is a leader

explanation.surface: The chief of the Cockneys sheltering a swimmer, perhaps a lifeguard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps Cockney leader' is a Bow head, someone at the head of Bow, the district tied to Cockneys by Bow Bells.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arctic whale is a legally protected species that swims in polar seas.

clue.text: Fruit girl pursues latest trends

parts.note: Rose is a girl's name
hip means in step with the newest fashions

explanation.surface: A young woman chasing whatever is fashionable.
explanation.walkthrough: HIP (fashionable) is an adjective standing for 'latest trends', a loose equivalence.
explanation.definitionFit: The red seed pod of a wild rose bush is a fruit, used for syrup.

clue.text: Neo grumbles about the mother- in-law

indicators.note: turned about, so the letters read backwards

parts.note: Neo is the setter, who refers to themself as I
moan means grumbles

explanation.surface: The setter complains about his mother-in-law, an old joke.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Book of Ruth, Ruth stays loyal to her husband's mother.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Bible, Ruth's husband's mother is the woman named, the classic devoted mother-in-law.

clue.text: Very soon scoundrel gets a girlfriend

parts.note: in a mo, short for in a moment, means very soon
a rat is a scoundrel

explanation.surface: A rogue is about to find himself a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian-derived word means a female lover or sweetheart.

clue.text: Left-winger, stoical, is thrown out

indicators.note: thrown out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A calm, stoical leftist gets expelled from the party.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone on the political left supports collective ownership and redistribution.

clue.text: Uniform-free messenger loading with spice

indicators.note: the messenger takes on a load inside
free of the letter, so it is dropped

parts.note: a courier is a messenger
Uniform is U in the NATO phonetic alphabet
and means with, joining things

explanation.surface: A delivery man out of uniform loads his van with spices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'free' drops U from COURIER, leaving CORIER, which then takes in AND.
explanation.definitionFit: The seeds of this herb are ground as a spice in curries.

clue.text: Popular new artist wasted or on the wagon?

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable

indicators.note: wasted, as in drunk, so these letters are in disarray

explanation.surface: A fashionable new artist: is he drunk, or teetotal?
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the wagon' usually means abstaining from drink; the question mark flags the literal sense, riding a wagon on its way.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally aboard a wagon is being carried somewhere, travelling on the way.

clue.text: National president meets resistance

parts.note: François Hollande was president of France in 2016
R is the symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: A national president faces opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the Netherlands is a national of that country.

clue.text: Nine-headed monster nut eviscerated in main outlet

parts.note: the Hydra of Greek myth had nine heads

indicators.note: with its insides removed, leaving only the outside letters

explanation.surface: A many-headed beast gutted in a principal exit.
explanation.definitionFit: A street tap for firefighters draws water from the water main.

clue.text: Man soon consumes ton

indicators.note: eating something takes it inside

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon

explanation.surface: A man will shortly eat an enormous amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name, such as Chekhov's, is enough for the vague definition.

clue.text: Privatiser's point, in writing, about large Old English uprising

indicators.note: the point goes about the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: a nib is the point of a pen

indicators.note: in a down entry, rising means read upwards, so backwards

explanation.surface: A privatiser makes a point in print about a big uprising in old England.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns L and OE to EOL, which NIB goes about.
explanation.definitionFit: A free-market neoliberal favours selling off state assets to the private sector.

clue.text: Half-dead left-winger tours one Michigan city

indicators.note: only the first half of the word dead is kept
touring something goes around it, so one piece encircles the other

parts.note: a Trot is short for a Trotskyist
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An exhausted Trotskyist on a speaking tour.
explanation.definitionFit: The motor city is the largest urban centre in the state of Michigan.

clue.text: Judgment important as teaching shows

indicators.note: the words put the letters on display within them

explanation.surface: Evidence that good teaching matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Discernment in matters of style or beauty is a kind of aesthetic judgment.

clue.text: Beat to suit musical piece

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them
go, as in 'those colours go together', means suit or match

explanation.surface: A rhythm composed to fit a piece of music.
explanation.definitionFit: The Argentine dance gives its name to a piece of music written in its rhythm.

clue.text: Native American soldier brought back to a little house

indicators.note: brought back means the letters are reversed

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper
HO is the abbreviation for house

explanation.surface: A soldier is returned to a small home.
explanation.definitionFit: The Plains people of Colorado and Wyoming are one of the Native American nations.

clue.text: Among ex-drinkers, Thomas Stearns Eliot initially confused

indicators.note: the initials sit among the other letters, inside them

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, a group of former drinkers

indicators.note: only the first letters of the three names are wanted

explanation.surface: The poet T. S. Eliot bewildered at a meeting of recovering alcoholics.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom of being adrift on the ocean means bewildered or lost.

clue.text: Sailor getting damaged kept dry

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman
stained means marked or damaged

explanation.surface: A sailor with a blemished record stayed off the drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'kept dry' means refrained from alcohol, not stayed out of the water.
explanation.definitionFit: Going dry means refusing alcohol, and holding back from drink is to refrain.

clue.text: South American greeting for tasty Asian dish

parts.note: US means American
hi is a greeting

explanation.surface: A South American welcome for a delicious oriental meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Vinegared rice with raw fish is a celebrated Japanese food.

clue.text: Pub, rat-hole, wrecked by clever group in opposition

indicators.note: a wreck is broken up, so these letters are scattered

parts.note: arty means cultured or artistically clever, a loose equivalence

explanation.surface: A cultured crowd trashes a squalid pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrecked' turns PUB RAT HOLE into THELABOURP.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's main left-wing party was the official Opposition in 2016.
